about_the_game:
COLLIDE WITH THE QUANTUM REALM

As a massive neutrino, you'll journey through the ever-shifting depths of the subatomic universe. Face the elusive Higgs Bosons and chase the shadows of a hidden force that defies all known physics, in a realm where reality bends, probabilities collapse, and every particle holds the key to rewriting the universe.

SHAPE YOUR RUN, BEND REALITY

Choose from a wide range of quantum tools, each with unique playstyles and surprising synergies. Weapons and upgrades let you shape every run, crafting builds that reflect your approach to conflict. Unleash attacks that bend space, manipulate mass, and unlock your full potential.

OBSERVE THE SUBATOMIC PARTICLES

Dive into a vibrant cast of quantum entities, each inspired by real subatomic particles. From swift neutrinos to volatile quarks and enigmatic gluons, every character brings unique abilities and behaviors shaped by the laws of physics. Discover their strengths...and their instability!

LET'S GET PHYSICAL!

Every environment, mechanic, and enemy is based on real scientific principles! Wave-particle duality, entanglement, vacuum fluctuations and many more...each level is a playable representation of the weirdness of quantum mechanics!

TOGETHER AS ONE
You are not a single being. You are a population. Entanglement gives you a shared consciousness projected across multiple units. Every failure is just another observation. Every return, another chance to collapse. Start over, but carry with you what you’ve come to understand.

NEW RUN NEW RULES

Each time you start over with a new neutrino, a fresh configuration awaits: rooms, paths, and weapons are reshuffled to offer a constantly changing challenge. No run is ever the same! Your combat style shifts, your discoveries vary, even your enemies evolve. Get ready to adapt, explore, and uncover new combinations every time.

CHOICE SUPERPOSITION

The quantum universe of Mass Eve is unstable, on the verge of collapse, and searching for balance. Two opposing forces struggle to shape its fate: one pushing toward entropy and radical change, the other seeking to preserve order and the coherence of fundamental laws.
Your actions, the alliances you forge, and the systems you choose to defend or dismantle will determine the weight of your trajectory. In a world where every observation has consequences, choice isn’t an option—it’s inevitable.

name: MassEve

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.4ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060, Radeon RX 5600XT, or Intel Arc A580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: The quantum world is on the edge of revolution, and only neutrinos can shift its fate. Mass-Eve is a fast-paced roguelike twin-stick shooter diving deep into the mysteries of modern physics. The future of the universe depends on your choices, are you ready to reshape it?
